registered_before: any v6 computation (no v6 fit, profile, held-out or blend value exists). Known at registration: P7.0/P7.1 results (Dooley 2012 passes LHV, fails H and aromatics), all v5/Phase 6 results, and the user's preliminary Phase 7 blend diagnostics (not registered results).
naming: Phase number 7 and calibration version 6 are distinct; every v6 artifact is named *_v6 and written under outputs/phase7/ (write-once).
change_from_v5: fuel only: Jet A = Dooley et al. (2012) surrogate (JetA_dooley2012 in data/fuel_properties_v7.yaml, P7.0 commit 4b8eeda), replacing pure n-dodecane. No other physics, parameter, bound, weight, budget or rule changes.

fuel.P7.1_outcomes_preserved: LHV pass (43.38 vs 43.1 MJ/kg liquid basis); hydrogen FAIL (14.12 vs 13.77 %); aromatics FAIL (26.1 vs 18.7 %). A published composition for POSF 4658 is not proof of matching POSF 10325.
fuel.cycle_basis: gas-phase species enthalpies (CRECK thermo) in the HP equilibrium, as for every v1-v5 fuel; no vaporisation correction in the cycle

split: outputs/phase6/split_p61.json (unchanged; held-out targets are read only by the held-out step)

eta_b_proxy.convention: UNCHANGED from v5: the per-mode eta_b values above are the registered Phase 6 calibration-group proxy eta_b = 1 - (EI_CO*Q_CO + EI_HC*Q_fuel)/(1000*Q_fuel) with Q_fuel = 44.462 MJ/kg (n-C12H26, the v5 production surrogate). They are NOT recomputed with the Dooley 2012 heating value; the proxy is kept as a fixed temperature-rise scaling so that the fuel is the only change. Recorded as an explicit convention, not a physical claim.

fit.objective: thrust_matched_v5: sum_i w_i e_i^2, e_i = relative fuel-flow error (unreachable row: e_i = 1.0)
fit.weighting: each split group equal; records equal within a group; modes equal (recertifications and input-twin models share one group weight)
fit.polish: scipy least_squares (trf, bounds, x_scale = box widths, diff_step 1e-4)
candidates: (1) tpe_then_polish: Optuna TPESampler(seed 42), 150 trials over the box in FIT_ORDER, then least_squares polish (max_nfev 100) from the best trial; the candidate value is min(polished, best trial) exactly as lto_v5.fit
(2) polish_from_v5_A2: least_squares polish (max_nfev 100) from the v5 A2 optimum (outputs/calibration_v5_A2.json params). This is a second registered start, NOT a new pilot.
fit.evaluation_order: candidate (1) then (2) in one process (same model object; warm-start phi guesses are shared, and run_at_thrust returns the same root cold or warm)
fit.selection: lower calibration SSE; exact ties go to candidate (1). Both candidates are recorded.
fit.unreachable_rows: ThrustTargetUnreachable rows scored e = 1.0 (unchanged); any other exception aborts (unchanged)

identifiability.rule: IDENTIFIED iff D >= 3.841 at both box edges (95 % profile interval interior to the box) AND the interval width <= 50 % of the box width
identifiability.penalty_guard: A parameter is NOT called IDENTIFIED if any verdict-deciding grid point (both box edges and the grid points bracketing each 95 % interval end, or the grid minimum and its neighbours when no grid point lies inside) has a returned inner optimum with any unreachable (penalised) calibration row, or an unknown count. Such a parameter is reported as 'penalty_dependent' and A1 fails. The count is taken from the objective log at the returned optimum (re-evaluated once if absent).
reported_not_gating: inner fits that stopped at the 40-evaluation cap (status 0), per grid point, and whether any verdict-deciding point is capped (an unconverged inner fit can only overstate D)
grid step and whether any grid point lies inside each 95 % interval (grid resolution)
box-scaled J^T J condition at the optimum
whether the profile minimum is below the fit SSE
identifiability.A1: PASS iff every fitted parameter is IDENTIFIED under the rule and the penalty guard

baselines.B0: constant TSFC: per mode, group-weighted calibration mean of ICAO FF / F_target, times the held-out F_target
baselines.B1: F-A rule: nearest-rated-thrust calibration group (ties: mean over tied groups) per-mode mean ICAO fuel flow x (held-out rated thrust / that group's rated thrust)

metrics.primary: group-weighted MAPE over all held-out rows (weights as in the fit)

acceptance.A1_identifiability: every parameter in the final fitted set IDENTIFIED (full profile)
acceptance.A2_rule: PASS iff primary MAPE_model <= min(MAPE_B0, MAPE_B1) - 0.25 pp; ESCALATE (plan section 9) iff MAPE_model > MAPE_B0 + 0.25 pp; otherwise 'no demonstrated skill' (fails A2, reported)
acceptance.A3_opr_trend: per mode, OLS slope of TSFC_i = FF_i / F_target,i on OPR_i across held-out groups (one point per group: group mean OPR, group-weighted mean TSFC), computed for ICAO data and for model predictions; PASS iff the signs agree in all three modes. Partial slope controlling for rated thrust is reported, not gating
acceptance.A4_informativeness: tests/test_holdout_informativeness.py passes on the v5 CSV

heldout.A4: the assertions of tests/test_holdout_informativeness.py::test_v5_holdout_prediction_depends_on_the_cycle applied to the v6 table (lto_v6.a4_informativeness; equivalence tested on the v5 CSV)
heldout.reported: model/B0/B1 group-weighted and record-level MAPE, overall and per mode; calibration airflow W_ref (v6, v5, v4 hand-set 79.9 kg/s); v5-to-v6 parameter and metric changes. No held-out value is used to choose anything.

nox: worker engines refit the NOx correlation without the held-out models (lto_v5._init_worker, asserted); every v6 NOx(corr) value is from the calibration-only fit. The correlation's inputs (ICAO OPR, fuel flow) do not involve the fuel, so the P6.1 NOx split validation (3.77 % vs 10.60 %) is unchanged and is not re-run.
dependency: P7.3 production blends run only if A1 PASS and the existing B0 escalation (A2 'ESCALATE') is not triggered; otherwise the result is recorded and P7.3 is gate-closed. The held-out step runs regardless (it reports the calibration). Independent P7.4 work continues either way.
